'''2013 Worlds Day 2 Drew Powers DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Drew Powers]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Day 2 Dark is the same as the Day 1 Agents Of Black Sun list.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Ref2-D-agentsofblacksun.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
